tweets.text: The reason your AI coding bill is unpredictable: every task defaults to the most expensive frontier model, whether it needs it or not. But the cheapest capable model for a job is often a fraction of the priciest. MiMo-V2.5-Pro clears 47.6% on Terminal Bench 2.0 at $4.92 a run. GPT-5.5 leads at 74.2%, for $72.63. Match the model to the task and the cost curve bends.
